svg.title: Medical AI data pipeline
svg.desc: Data flow from raw medical sources through ingestion, embedding, vector store, retrieval, reranking, LLM, and response

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What raw medical data sources are ingested?')
sendPrompt('How are medical images like X-rays ingested into the pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How is medical literature like PubMed used in RAG?')
sendPrompt('How is real-time wearable sensor data ingested for remote monitoring?')
sendPrompt('How is camera and video stream data processed for remote monitoring?')

g.text: chunk · clean · OCR · de-identify (PHI removal) · normalize

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How are medical text chunks embedded for vector search?')
sendPrompt('How is raw and processed medical data stored in MongoDB and Postgres?')
sendPrompt('How is the medical vector index built and maintained?')
sendPrompt('How does a patient query get processed through the RAG pipeline?')
sendPrompt('How does hybrid search combine vector and BM25 for medical queries?')
sendPrompt('How does the reranker improve medical search results?')
sendPrompt('How does the LLM use retrieved medical context to generate a response?')
sendPrompt('What happens to top-k medical context chunks before the LLM?')

svg.text: Filtered + cited response → output_filter → API → Flutter / React
